r203_K04.speaker: serena
r203_K04.text: 哎呀！辣椒月饼也不能往脸上扔呀！

r203_S08.speaker: serena
r203_S08.text: 我还没投币呢！汽水就砸过来啦！

r203_P03.speaker: serena
r203_P03.text: 哎呀！恐龙是纸箱做的也不能踩我呀！

r203_X05.speaker: serena
r203_X05.text: 啊！这么多作业，先让我把脸露出来呀！

r203_Q07.speaker: serena
r203_Q07.text: 等等！天上的月亮怎么掉到我头上啦！

idle.speaker: serena
idle.text: 喂，对面那位，你的牌怎么一股食堂味儿？

idle_v2.speaker: serena
idle_v2.text: 等一下，我不是紧张，我是在等一个很帅的出场。

r208_G06.speaker: serena
r208_G06.text: 第二页！才是真正的计划！

r208_P02.speaker: serena
r208_P02.text: 这球一百年也该进了吧！

r208_P07.speaker: serena
r208_P07.text: 天鹅选手，请表演慢动作！

r208_Q08.speaker: serena
r208_Q08.text: 不许出圈！这是课堂纪律！

r208_S01.speaker: serena
r208_S01.text: 倒回一分钟！再迟到一次！

r208_S07.speaker: serena
r208_S07.text: 放学铃响了！又是星期一！

cast.speaker: Dylan
cast.text: 该我反击了！看看这一招！
cast.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

hurt.speaker: Dylan
hurt.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

cast_v2.speaker: Dylan
cast_v2.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

cast_v3.speaker: Dylan
cast_v3.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

cast_v4.speaker: Dylan
cast_v4.text: 换我来出牌了，你可别走神！
cast_v4.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

hurt_v2.speaker: Dylan
hurt_v2.text: 等等，这招比想象中厉害！
hurt_v2.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

hurt_v3.speaker: Dylan
hurt_v3.text: 别高兴得太早，我还有后招！
hurt_v3.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

r202_E06.speaker: dylan
r202_E06.text: 哎哟！谁拿黑板擦砸我的脑袋！

r202_Q05.speaker: dylan
r202_Q05.text: 阿嚏！粉笔记者会怎么开到我鼻子里了！

r202_K01.speaker: dylan
r202_K01.text: 等等！为什么茄子和香蕉都砸过来了！

r202_K07.speaker: dylan
r202_K07.text: 啊！蛤蟆怎么跳到我肩膀上了！

r202_P07.speaker: dylan
r202_P07.text: 哎哟喂！天鹅滑冰怎么滑到我脚下啦！

r203_K04.speaker: dylan
r203_K04.text: 辣死我啦！谁把辣椒塞进月饼里了！

r203_S08.speaker: dylan
r203_S08.text: 哎哟！售货机怎么把汽水罐当炮弹啦！

r203_P03.speaker: dylan
r203_P03.text: 快跑！那个纸箱恐龙踩到我鞋了！

r203_X05.speaker: dylan
r203_X05.text: 救命！作业本怎么下起暴风雪啦！

r203_Q07.speaker: dylan
r203_Q07.text: 哎哟！教室里的第二个月亮砸我头了！

idle.speaker: dylan
idle.text: 我只是战略性发呆，别催。

idle_v2.speaker: dylan
idle_v2.text: 这张牌再不争气，我申请换个同桌。

r208_G06.speaker: dylan
r208_G06.text: 第二页！才是真正的计划！

r208_P02.speaker: dylan
r208_P02.text: 这球一百年也该进了吧！

r208_P07.speaker: dylan
r208_P07.text: 天鹅选手，请表演慢动作！

r208_Q08.speaker: dylan
r208_Q08.text: 不许出圈！这是课堂纪律！

r208_S01.speaker: dylan
r208_S01.text: 倒回一分钟！再迟到一次！

r208_S07.speaker: dylan
r208_S07.text: 放学铃响了！又是星期一！

enter.speaker: Vivian
enter.text: 报告！纸飞机转弯，马上抵达！
enter.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

attack.speaker: Vivian
attack.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

enter_v2.speaker: Vivian
enter_v2.text: 这班航线临时改道，请注意接收！
enter_v2.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

enter_v3.speaker: Vivian
enter_v3.text: 小纸飞机出发咯，记得给我留个降落点！
enter_v3.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

attack_v2.speaker: Vivian
attack_v2.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

attack_v3.speaker: Vivian
attack_v3.text: 逆风？那我就借风转过去！
attack_v3.loudness_processing: EBU R128 target -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP; Qwen3 source voice preserved

hurt.speaker: vivian
hurt.text: 哎呀！我的纸飞机怎么也中招了！

hurt_v2.speaker: vivian
hurt_v2.text: 纸飞机！快来帮我挡一下！

idle.speaker: vivian
idle.text: 别折我机翼，今天飞行证刚办好。

idle_v2.speaker: vivian
idle_v2.text: 我绕一圈回来，作业就算交了吗？
